1 · First half

How it started.

The Nets led 39–25 after one quarter. At the half, the Nets led 83–66.

2 · The difference

Demin: 22 points in his return

4 of 6 from three, 12 in the fourth, back after six games out.

3 · How it turned

Up 17 at the half, up as many as 41

Six Nets scored 15 or more, tying a franchise record.

4 · Where it was won

Won the arc and the glass

Threes made 20–12; assists 30–20. Brooklyn hit 20 threes to New Orleans’ 12.

5 · Final

Nets 145, Pelicans 111.
